name: review-accessibility-dpi-localization
prompt: Audit a production WPF operator console for keyboard access, screen-reader naming, high contrast, 100 to 200 percent DPI, text expansion, and right-to-left localization.
rubric: Defines evidence-based checks for keyboard navigation, focus order, automation names, and critical control semantics.
Covers high contrast, theme resources, scaling, clipping, text expansion, and right-to-left behavior.
Separates automated accessibility checks from required Windows manual verification.
